first_body: The target was the primary rows 1.2× faster than the first recorded run (92ce041). Measured today, final code against it, 3 pairs (92ce041 had no computer player, so those two rows are missing): ×0.893 (last run measured ×0.968 on its own code; the two runs’ VMs differ, so compare within a run only). Called better: a shared game’s page −44%, reopening a long game −31%. Called worse: joining’s first board frame 1.57 → 5.12 s (+216%), the opponent’s move landing 136 → 215 ms (+58%; against main this run it was −5.8%, not called, so it came in before this branch; it was +4.6% uncalled last run), the phone start page +7.4%. Still worse in the diagnostics: the first pick 33 ms → 764 ms (2.34 s last run), JS heap on a reopened 2,000-ply game +34%, one texture more after 16 plies (the garden copy, not a leak: X5a). The lobby, the garden, the preview and the entrance all came after 92ce041; the join remains the largest wait.
